real: M1064 120 mm mortar carrier (M113 hull; unit_sheet: 2B11-class 120 mm, M2 Browning 12.7 mm)
shape: unit_sheet.json Phương tiện: an M113 hull with the rear roof hatch opened wide and the 120 mm mortar pointing up through it; from above the big roof hatch and the mortar tube; about 3.9 x 2.2 x 2.0 m (0.8 x M1064); the def's modelSize 4.21 x 2.3 x 3.2 m (the tube up) wins; team stripes; no insignia.

features.feature: the M113 box hull (Team) with rounded plate edges, the sponson lip over the top run, the lower hull
the folded trim vane on the glacis, hinges, lamps, tow hooks, smoke launchers on the glacis corners
driver's hatch and periscopes, engine grilles, the exhaust on the right side
the three-leaf mortar hatch over the rear roof folded open: coaming, the leaves, hinges, the well floor
the mortar on its turntable: traverse ring, the long tube raised 70 degrees with its blast ring, bipod and elevation mechanism, traversing screw, sight, ready rounds in a rack
the commander's cupola with vision blocks and the M2 on its raised ring with shield, its ammunition can
the dismount baseplate on the left side, the aiming stakes and their bag, a crate and a jerrycan
five road wheels, front sprocket, rear idler on its arm, the track; the rear ramp with its door, the armoured fuel tanks, tail lamps; Team bands
